description: Install the user's SSH PUBLIC key on either pilot and return its SSH connection instructions through the restricted relay. The smaller database pilot works on its own; no website pilot is needed. Application ports stay private. Reuse or generate an Ed25519 key locally; send only its public key, never its private key. Inspect get_private_vps_action until complete. Add the returned verified public host keys to local known_hosts and use the matching local private key path in BOTH parts of the returned SSH command. Give that command to the user at the end, including after a failed application install. Never claim SSH is ready for an unknown or failed access action.
name: get_private_vps_ssh
title: Get pilot SSH access
